nodes.name: Make the presenter clip with Orshot

parameters.content:
# Create faceless YouTube Shorts with an AI presenter using OpenAI and Orshot

Post a faceless YouTube Short every day with a talking AI presenter. OpenAI writes the script, Orshot turns it into a lip-synced clip and renders it into your 9:16 template with captions, and YouTube gets the finished MP4.

### Who's it for
- Faceless channel owners who want one Short a day without filming, voiceovers or editing
- Creators who want one consistent presenter and the same look on every video

### How it works
- A schedule starts the workflow every day at 9am
- OpenAI writes a topic, hook, spoken script, stat, title and description for your niche
- Orshot makes a lip-synced presenter clip from the script and your reference photo
- Orshot renders the clip into your template and captions it from the clip's audio
- The MP4 is downloaded and uploaded to YouTube as a private Short

### Setup
- Copy the faceless Short template into your workspace (link in the guide) and note its ID
- Add the Orshot node, then create an Orshot API credential with your key; both Orshot HTTP Request nodes use it
- Add your OpenAI and YouTube credentials
- Fill in **Configure**: niche, handle, template ID and a photo URL of your presenter
- Full guide: [Automate faceless videos with n8n](https://orshot.com/blog/how-to-make-faceless-videos-with-n8n)
- Product page: [Orshot video API](https://orshot.com/solutions/video-generation-api)

### Requirements
- [Orshot](https://orshot.com) account on a paid plan (AI video is paid-only)
- OpenAI API key ([OpenAI credentials in n8n](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/credentials/openai/))
- YouTube channel with [YouTube Data API](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3) access via [Google credentials in n8n](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/credentials/google/)

### Customization tips
- Swap the schedule for a Google Sheets trigger to render one Short per row
- Change the photo and voice in **Configure** for a different presenter
- Set privacy to public once you trust the output

## 1. Write today's fact
**Configure** holds your niche, handle, template ID and presenter photo. OpenAI returns the on-screen text plus a short spoken script.

## 2. Presenter and render
Orshot turns the script into a lip-synced clip, then renders it into your template. `subtitleSource` points at that clip, so the captions always match the new voice.

## 3. Post it
The MP4 is downloaded and uploaded to YouTube as a private Short so you can review it before it goes public.
